First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Red Hot Ladies Roving Ride group ride

A women's riding group under the Hawaii Bicycling League. The Sunday Roving Ride is a moderate no-drop ride of 20 to 50 miles with a rotating start; the Cruisers and Cosmos rides the same morning are shorter, beginner-friendly options. Contact the leader for the week's start.
